Current Microsoft Learn Windows-service guidance says a service should be stopped before deletion and DeleteService/sc delete only marks the service for deletion until it is no longer running and outstanding service handles are closed. Talvora canonical upgrades therefore preserve the existing service registration and reconfigure its binPath rather than deleting it as an upgrade fallback. The deploy launcher also releases a service-hosted MCP request instead of waiting on the same SYSTEM installer task that must stop that service. Live evidence: the pre-fix 2026-09-30 deploy hit SCM 7034 and timed out while deleting Talvora; the detached source-fixed launcher returned waitForCompletion=false and the same 29f009e installer then moved 34%→50% in 0.31 seconds, installed successfully, and produced no new SCM 7034 event.
